scheme_name: Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund - Kargil Package
other_conditions: Application must be submitted within 6 months from the date of the accident (or from the date of death if death occurs during treatment).
The death or injury must have occurred on or after 18‑02‑2019.
Beneficiary must be a dependent of the deceased soldier or the disabled soldier.
benefits_summary: Provides Rs 1 lakh to dependents of soldiers killed in an accident and up to Rs 20,000 for serious injuries, provided the application is made within 6 months.
documents_required: Death or disability certificate of the soldier
